name: SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after round 5 once the last player has passed

categories.label: Score track (VP gained during play)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên bảng điểm (tích lũy trong ván)
categories.hint: Marker position at end of round 5, before final scoring. Past 100 = add 100 per lap.

categories.label: End-of-game cards VP total
categories.labelVi: Tổng điểm thẻ tính điểm cuối
categories.hint: Total points from played cards with a gold box.

categories.label: Gold scoring tiles VP total
categories.hint: Sum over the gold tiles you marked at 25/50/70 VP: sets of the tile's condition x your marker value on that tile. Skip tiles you never reached.

categories.label: Alien species bonus scoring
categories.hint: Only if a discovered alien species adds an extra end-game scoring step.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: players with equal points share the tie.
tiebreakers.descriptionVi: Không có luật phân định: người hòa điểm cùng thắng.

notes: Gold tiles are entered as one total (3 of 4 in play): Tech (sets of 3 types / pairs of techs), Mission (completed missions / pairs of missions+end-game cards), Income (sets of 3 income types / most-tucked type), Other (sets of 3 life-trace colours / sector wins paired with orbiter or lander). Marker values on each tile depend on selection order (first picker gets highest). Each gold milestone can only pick a tile not already marked by that player. Solo: rival scores 5 per uncompleted objective instead of gold tiles. Expansion 'Space Agencies' not modelled. Which gold-tile side is in play is not recorded.

sources.title: SETI rulebook EN (CGE, 2024-09-17)
sources.section: p.18 Milestones (gold milestones at 25/50/70); p.21 End of Game (final scoring, gold scoring tiles); p.22 solo end of game

uiHintReason: Score track plus three simple end totals (cards, gold tiles, alien bonus).
winConditionVi: Điểm cao nhất thắng. Hòa điểm thì cùng thắng. Ván kết thúc sau vòng 5 khi người cuối cùng bỏ lượt.
